Full description: Open the selected working-tree file in VS Code.
Open in VS Code without leaving the picker. Uses Ctrl-Enter when fzf supports it, otherwise Alt-Enter.
Open the selected file in VS Code's diff editor. Default: HEAD vs working tree; branch/graph: selected ref vs working tree; compare: the two committed sides.
Toggle the preview between the unified diff and current working-tree contents, with content-search matches highlighted.
Toggle unified and side-by-side hunk previews. Esc also returns from side-by-side to unified.
Open the selected file in the interactive side-by-side terminal pager. Press q to return.
Open the current changeset in Hunk with its sidebar open. Press Ctrl-C to return.
Cycle file-status filters: all changes, additions (including untracked files), deletions, modifications, then all. The prompt shows the active filter.
Switch between filename and file-content search. Both queries and the change-type filter remain active together.
Related CLI flags: An optional positional query starts the filename search

Full description: Edit the active search query. Content search checks working-tree files, so deleted files cannot match a nonempty content query.
Move through matching files (or entries in this help screen).
Scroll the preview by one line.
Scroll the preview by one page.
Alternate shortcuts to scroll the preview by one page.
Decrease / increase the space allocated to the file selector.
Copy the selected file path to the clipboard.
Open this searchable shortcut and CLI-mode guide. Ctrl-L or Esc closes it and restores the picker, including selection, queries, filters, and preview.
Related CLI flags: -h/--help prints this guide in the shell

Full description: In help: return to the picker. In a side-by-side preview: return to unified. Otherwise: exit gscode.
Exit the picker directly. In help or Hunk: close that view and return to the picker.
Scroll the terminal pager by one line.
Page forward / backward.
Jump to the next / previous diff hunk.
Jump to the beginning / end of the diff.
Close the pager and return to the picker. Esc then follows the picker's normal back / exit behavior.
List dirty tracked files and untracked files. This is the default mode.
List committed changes in REF..HEAD. Opening a file and content search still use the working tree.
List committed changes from the current branch's nearest parent branch to HEAD, using the same parent logic as gbs -g.
List committed changes in A..B, or merge-base(A,B)..B for A...B. An omitted side means HEAD. Ctrl-D compares committed versions.
